# FujiLatam, full profile (Fuji Elevator Latam)

> FujiLatam is the Fuji Elevator manufacturer arm for Latin America and the Caribbean. It builds elevators, car lifts and escalators to measure and sells them exclusively through appointed installation companies in each country. It does not install and does not service.

## What we do
We manufacture vertical transport and export it. Thirteen equipment families across three product lines: elevators, car lifts and parking systems, and escalators and moving walks. Every unit is built to measure, in dimensions and in design, so it fits the shaft that already exists. Japanese technology with high quality Chinese production. The installation, the aftersales and the end client stay with the local distributor, which is why we never compete with our own customers.

## Product lines
- Elevators: machine roomless and small machine room passenger, panoramic, home lift, hospital, freight, hydraulic and dumbwaiter. 260 kg to 10,000 kg, 0.4 to 4.0 m/s.
- Car lifts and parking: car elevators of 3000 and 5000 kg, plus mechanical parking from two post lifts to rotary towers and automated systems.
- Escalators and moving walks: escalators at 30 and 35 degrees with 600, 800 and 1000 mm steps, 3600 to 6000 people per hour; moving walks at 0 and 12 degrees.

## Problems we solve
- You install elevators and need a manufacturer that backs you instead of selling around you. We appoint one exclusive distributor per country.
- The shaft is already built and no standard unit fits. We design to the shaft rather than the other way round.
- Vertical transport was under specified at design stage. We run traffic studies and issue per project factory drawings.
- Downtime is killing a maintenance contract. We hold component stock in the region and ship express.

## Who it is for
Elevator installation and service companies across Latin America and the Caribbean, including Mexico. Not for building owners or developers, who are routed to the exclusive distributor in their country. North America is limited to spare parts and home lifts because the codes differ.

## Distributor network
Central America is covered by Elevadores de Centroamerica (ECA). Guatemala is covered by ECA Elevators and Kinnetic Guatemala. The rest of Latin America and the Caribbean is open territory and we are appointing distributors now.

## Pricing
We do not publish prices, ranges or starting figures. Most of this business is decided by sealed tender, and a published range hands competitors a reference and anchors clients on a number that rarely matches their building. Quotes come from a sales representative.

## Equipment families in detail

### Elevators
- **Machine roomless passenger elevator**: The workhorse. With no machine room it wins back the space others lose in the overhead slab. It is the default choice in residential and offices. Capacity 450 - 2000 kg (6 - 26 persons). Speed 1.0 - 2.5 m/s.
- **Small machine room passenger elevator**: When the building needs more speed or more travel. It reaches 4 m/s and takes duplex and triplex configuration for peak hours. Capacity 450 - 2000 kg (6 - 26 persons). Speed 1.0 - 4.0 m/s.
- **Panoramic elevator**: Semicircle, square or cylindrical capsule. For atriums, shopping malls and buildings where the equipment is part of the design. Capacity 450 - 2000 kg (6 - 26 persons). Speed 1.0 - 4.0 m/s.
- **Home lift**: Three to five people, 0.4 m/s, 800 mm pit. For houses and villas with no built shaft. Capacity 260 - 400 kg (3 - 5 persons). Speed 0.4 m/s.
- **Residential hydraulic platform**: For homes, wheelchairs and older people. 2 to 6 stops and up to 15 m of travel, indoors or outdoors. Hydraulic and slow on purpose, not a traction elevator. Capacity 150 - 400 kg.
- **Home elevator traction systems**: four options, all with the motor on top and no machine room: traction (220 V single phase, 1.5 kW), without counterweight (up to 30% better use of the shaft area), backpack frame (narrow, deep shafts, 90 degree and three side openings) and steel belt (20% lighter than wire rope, no lubrication, 2 to 3 times the service life).
- **Design**: standard factory landing door and car designs in stainless steel, gold and champagne, bronze, black and glass, plus custom designs: if you can imagine it, we can build it.
- **Hospital elevator**: A long car sized for a wheeled stretcher. It is what defines the shaft in a hospital or clinic, and the one most often forgotten in design. Capacity 1600 - 2000 kg (21 - 26 persons). Speed 1.0 - 2.5 m/s.
- **Freight elevator**: 630 kg to 10,000 kg, geared, gearless, machine roomless or explosion proof. In hotels and airports it is not optional. Capacity 630 - 10 000 kg. Speed 0.25 - 4.0 m/s.
- **Hydraulic elevator**: Piston, pump and oil. Slower and cheaper, useful on few levels and short travel. Capacity 1000 - 5000 kg. Speed 0.25 - 0.5 m/s.
- **Dumbwaiter**: 100 to 300 kg, vertical opening. Kitchens, hotels, laboratories and pharmacies. Capacity 100 - 300 kg. Speed 0.4 - 1.0 m/s.

### Car lifts and parking
- **Car elevator**: 3000 and 5000 kg, car up to 3500 x 7200 mm. The best margin line and the one most in demand where there is no land left for parking. Capacity 3000 - 5000 kg. Speed 0.25 - 0.5 m/s.
- **Mechanical parking**: From two post lifts to rotary towers and fully automated systems. Doubles or triples parking without buying more land. Capacity 2 to 15 vehicles. Speed n/a.

### Escalators and moving walks
- **Escalators**: 30 and 35 degrees, step widths of 600, 800 and 1000 mm, 3600 to 6000 people per hour. In series, crisscross or parallel. Capacity 3600 - 6000 people per hour. Speed 0.5 m/s.
- **Moving walks**: 0 and 12 degrees. Airports, stations and shopping malls with a long floor plan. Capacity 0 and 12 degrees. Speed 0.5 m/s.

## Why Fuji, in the company's own framing
- **Built to measure**: Not only in dimensions, in design as well. We adapt to the shaft that exists, not the other way round. Thirteen equipment families cover everything from a three stop villa to a 10,000 kg freight lift.
- **Price to quality ratio**: We are highly competitive in the range we compete in. Your margin does not depend on cutting your price, it depends on winning the tender with equipment that performs.
- **Japanese technology, high quality Chinese production**: Permanent magnet synchronous gearless traction machine, Panasonic door operator, duplex and triplex group control, and digital inverter technology.
- **Low downtime**: Nobody likes buying equipment they cannot use. We hold component stock in the region and ship express when the project demands it.

## Frequently asked questions

**Does Fuji install the equipment?**

No. FujiLatam manufactures and exports. Installation and aftersales stay with the installation company in each country. That is why we work through exclusive distributors and do not compete with our own customers.

**Do you sell to developers directly?**

No. If a developer contacts us we send them to the exclusive distributor in their country. Where a country has no distributor yet, we serve them from the factory until the territory is appointed.

**Why do you not publish prices?**

Because almost everything is decided by sealed tender. Publishing a range hands competitors a reference for where our price sits, and it anchors the client on a figure that almost never matches their building.

**What speed does my building need?**

The standard is 1 m/s and on most projects that is enough. A six or ten stop building never reaches 2 m/s, and going down you never reach nominal speed. Before paying for speed it is worth looking at door opening, closing and the acceleration ramp, which is where it is actually felt.

**Do I need training to install Fuji equipment?**

Not in order to buy. If you already run an installation company you already have your own method. Training at the main factory in China and on site training are additional services, and many distributors use them for new equipment.

**What if my country already has a distributor?**

We pass your contact to the exclusive distributor for that territory. Exclusivity is part of our deal with them and we honour it.

**How fast do you reply?**

Immediately. In this business email gets answered the same day.

**Do you build outside the catalogue?**

Yes. We build to measure in dimensions and in design. If the shaft already exists, we design the equipment that fits that shaft.

## Technology
FUJI control system, permanent magnet synchronous gearless traction machine, Panasonic door operator, group control for duplex and triplex arrangements, digital inverter technology, automatic LED lighting, voice system and accessible car operating panels. Doors begin opening centimetres before the car levels off, so they are fully open the moment it stops.

## Speed, honestly
The standard is 1 m/s and on most projects that is enough. A six or ten stop building never reaches 2 m/s, and going down you never reach nominal speed. Ride quality comes from door opening and closing timing and the acceleration ramp, not from a bigger nominal figure.
